description: Telecom API platform for SMS messaging, voice calls, and messaging webhooks.

send_sms.name: send_sms
send_sms.description: Send an SMS message using the Telnyx Messages API.

from.description: The sending number or sender ID.

to.description: The destination phone number in E.164 format.

aiMetadata.description: Sends an outbound SMS via Telnyx from a sender number/ID to a destination phone number (E.164) with the given message body; optionally scope it to a specific messaging profile. Use to deliver a text message to a recipient. Not idempotent: each call sends a new message, so repeating it sends duplicates.

make_call.name: make_call
make_call.description: Initiate an outbound call using the Telnyx Call Control API.

connection_id.description: The Telnyx Call Control Application ID (formerly connection ID) used to place the call.

from.description: The caller ID number in E.164 format.

to.description: The destination number or SIP URI.

audio_url.description: Optional WAV or MP3 URL to play when the call is answered.

webhook_url.description: Optional URL that overrides the default Telnyx webhook destination for this call.

timeout_secs.description: How long to let the destination ring before timing out.

aiMetadata.description: Places an outbound voice call via the Telnyx Call Control API from a caller ID (E.164) to a destination number or SIP URI, using a required Call Control Application (connection) ID; can optionally play an audio file (WAV/MP3) on answer and override the webhook destination and ring timeout. Use to dial a recipient programmatically. Not idempotent: each call initiates a new call.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

message_received.name: message_received
message_received.description: Triggers when Telnyx delivers a message.received webhook event.

webhook_instructions.description:
To use this trigger, configure your Telnyx messaging webhook manually:

1. Open your Telnyx portal.
2. Go to the messaging profile or inbound messaging configuration you use for SMS.
3. Set the webhook URL to:

```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```

4. Make sure webhook API version is **v2**.
5. Enable or send **message.received** events to this webhook URL.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Telnyx delivers an inbound message via its message.received webhook, representing an incoming SMS/MMS received on a configured messaging profile. Requires manually configuring the Telnyx messaging webhook (v2) to the given URL; events for other event types are ignored.

pt.\nTo use this trigger, configure your Te:
Para usar esse gatilho, configure seu webhook de mensagem Telnyx manualmente:

1. Abra seu portal Telnyx.
2. Vá para o perfil de mensagens ou configuração de mensagens de entrada que você usa para SMS.
3. Define a URL do webhook para:

```text

```

4. Certifique-se de que a versão da API webhook seja **v2**.
5. Ativar ou enviar eventos **message.received** para este URL do webhook.
